baseline: 2,002,982 Works plus complete119,129,660Authors and fixed Institutions/Sources/Topics, exact historical input files

method: One primer then3warm EXPLAIN ANALYZE runs (TIMING OFF, BUFFERS, WAL, SETTINGS, FORMAT JSON), independent output fetch and typed canonical hash comparison to historical oracle. load: Witnessed DuckDB2.0 PostgreSQL extension writes projected Parquet data to vanilla PostgreSQL through SQL; no custom per-row JSON parser and no full intermediate CSV. scale_policy: First get2m measured, then consider10m and31.9m if laptop resource/disk/runtime observations allow. Do not promise fullcorpus. Retain complete Authors between tiers to avoid repeated119mload.
disk_guard: Do not expand Docker VM or stop unrelated containers. Stop further scaling if host free disk below80GiB or benchmark storage above150GiB.
updates: After baseline query measurements, witness and time transactional upsert/replacement of changed Work rows and child relationships using staging tables, plus idempotency and tombstone behavior on small batches. Restore original dataset using transaction rollback or explicit fixture DB so baseline outputs are preserved. Clearly label synthetic update batch, not a real newer snapshot sync.
report_limits: PostgreSQL query execution only, DuckDB used for loading, not for benchmark query execution. Memory caps and storage paths differ from historical/EC2 tests; comparisons are observed setups not isolated engine causality. Snapshot versioning/merged/deleted-ID handling discussed separately from update microexperiment. No minimum-resource or fullcorpus conclusion.
